cases.rationale: Direct joint-strength observation has the exact D3163 method and endpoint scope.
Direct endpoint cannot be relabelled when the method receipt reports another endpoint.
Ratio-of-means retention uses distinct destructive initial/aged specimens, matched lot clusters, D1151 conditioning and D3163 strength evidence.
Initial and aged D3163 specimens overlap despite destructive testing; the cohort identities are invalid.
A ratio-of-means result cannot be silently relabelled as a mean of specimen ratios.
Aged strength evidence lacks the conditioning practice receipt and exposure lineage.
Many coupons cannot compensate for fewer independent manufacturing lots than the frozen minimum.
Candidate aged observations are outside the same exact material-pair method scope.
The reported ratio does not reconcile to the referenced initial and aged means.
Derived result is not bound to an immutable preregistered plan digest.
A zero initial mean makes the ratio-of-means undefined and must not be silently repaired.
Initial and aged cohorts within an arm do not share the same preregistered lot-cluster pairing.
The D5573 SMC classification fraction counts unknown/unclassifiable specimens in the explicit denominator.
The reported denominator silently omits the unknown/unclassifiable specimen.
D5573 was developed for the SMC FRP family and does not establish a failure-mode taxonomy for polypropylene joints.
A descriptive classification fraction cannot establish failure-mode acceptability.
A single specimen cannot be counted twice in the failure-mode denominator.
Multiple raters without an adjudication receipt leave the specimen-level class unresolved.
Numerator does not equal the number of classified specimens in the declared category.
The result points to a different taxonomy version/digest from the frozen classification plan.
The aggregate result has no valid digest.
An unclassifiable specimen cannot simultaneously count as a known failure category.
The classified cohort has fewer independent lot clusters than the preregistered minimum.
